passenger_response.subject: Outcome of your disruption claim – AER-3B7Y5K
passenger_response.body:
Dear Tomas Ferreira,

Our record shows that flight AK640 on 2026-08-01 was cancelled because of a cabin pressurisation fault. You were re-accommodated on AK644 and arrived at your final destination 220 minutes late.

Your compensation is GBP 175.00. The distance was 1585 km, placing the journey in Band B. The technical cause was within Aerlink’s control. Because you were re-routed and your arrival delay was below 300 minutes, the standard Band B amount of GBP 350.00 was reduced by 50%.

You were also carried in ECONOMY after booking BUSINESS. This downgrade reimbursement is 50% of the affected segment S2 fare of GBP 480.00, which is GBP 240.00. It is based on that segment fare, not the booking total of GBP 1240.00, and excludes taxes, charges and ancillaries. This reimbursement is additional to compensation.

The total payment of GBP 415.00 has been paid under payment reference CMP-00015. It covers the statutory entitlement.

We have paid what the policy entitles you to. Anything beyond that is discretionary and is not ours to decide at this desk, so it has been passed on. Please do not read that as agreement that a further payment is due.

Regards,
Aerlink Disruption Desk
